Open [the fixture board](./index.html) in a browser. It runs offline with no installation.

The first Thursday is seeded with six pairings, giving every team two matches. Select a pencil to change a pairing or a plus to fill an open table. If a team is already booked in that slot, the editor identifies the other table and prevents the conflict.

Use the arrows to move between Thursdays. Changes survive closing and reopening the app when you use the same file and browser profile. **Print sheet** produces a one-page landscape schedule with 28-point team names.
